name: Camp Weber
description_short: A YMCA day camp for ages 6-12 on 75 wooded acres in West Springfield, MA, with an outdoor pool used for swim lessons and free swim. Campers are grouped into small units by age.
swim_waterfront_notes: A 60' x 45' L-shaped pool is used for both instructional and recreational swimming.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: No season year, dates, or prices on the page. The text looks old: it describes COVID-era rules like face masks, temperature checks, curbside pickup and 1-to-6 groups, and may not reflect the 2027 season.
The 'Health & Safety' and 'Well-Being' sections refer to the pandemic and may be out of date.
A one-time $15.00 Facility Maintenance Fee per camper is charged at first registration. This is not a deposit and not the program price.
Up-to-date physical and immunization forms are due at registration.
The 'Programs and Registration' link goes to a general YMCA page, not a Camp Weber registration form.
